descriptionByLocale.en:
The Lucerne Canton Hospital with its Lucerne, Sursee and Wolhusen sites is a company of the LUKS Group and is therefore one of the leading hospital groups in Switzerland. The more than 8500 employees are there with cordiality, competence and commitment around the clock for the well-being of patients. The clinics and institutes of the LUKS Group offer medical services of the highest quality. For our team we are looking for reinforcement on September 1, 2026 or by agreement. Tasks:
• As part of the hospital informatics, you work closely with all LUKS application teams, specialist experts and our American partner Epic. Together, ensure the operation and further development of the integrated Electronic Health Record (EHR) system Epic
• To meet the design of a quality system and the needs of LUKS, exchange with stakeholders at all levels and work closely with the database administrators
• Your tasks include the design of database analyses, the execution of system maintenance, testing and, if necessary, the training of users
• They are responsible for the need-oriented creation of reports, key figures and dashboards with the help of different tools for data analysis and visualization requirements:
• Complete study in computer science, data science, statistics or a related area forms the technical basis. Experience with analysis tools Python, Power BI, or Qlik as well as with database systems, Data Warehousing, SQL and ETL processes. knowledge of health care or interest in clinical processes
• Analytical thinking skills and a structured, solution-oriented manner help to identify complex relationships and develop practical solutions; some years of professional experience as well as ideal knowledge in SQL, data analysis and data modeling are very welcome
• They are already certified or ready in an Epic module, preferably Cogito, to acquire the modules relevant to this activity within the framework of multi-day training in the USA (currently virtual)
• Very good knowledge of German and English as well as a networked, careful and self-responsive way round off your profile; also convince you with high motivation, team skills and a supportive approach style in contact with users We offer:
• You have the chance to further develop the first commissioning of Epic in the German-speaking region and to actively shape the digitization process at the Lucerne Canton Hospital
• Business team spirit, an agile working environment, a modern understanding of leadership and an open corporate culture
• Our systems offer the tools for sound decisions in clinical and strategic issues at the largest centre hospital in Switzerland, where you can benefit from an internationally connected Epic community

descriptionByLocale.it:

Acute geriatrics at the Lucerne location is an established and dynamically growing unit with a center function for the region. It is recognized as a Category A continuing education center and makes a significant contribution to the care of older, multimorbid patients. A particular focus is on interdisciplinary collaboration - especially in the certified elderly accident center in close partnership with the Clinic for Orthopedics and Trauma Surgery. As part of the further development of the LUKS Group, there is an opportunity to actively shape geriatric care beyond the location, particularly in the sense of integrated care including rehabilitation, long-term care and referral networks. We are looking for reinforcements for our team on October 1, 2026 or by arrangement. Tasks:
• Co-responsibility for the clinical and strategic management of acute geriatrics at the Lucerne location, including its participation and further development in a dynamic clinical environment. Ensuring high-quality, evidence-based geriatric care
• Co-management and further development of the Geriatric Accident Center as an interdisciplinary lighthouse project for orthogeriatric care together with the Clinic for Orthopedics and Trauma Surgery. Active participation in the associated organizational and treatment processes
• Leadership and further development of a team of doctors, nursing and therapies. Promotion of interdisciplinary collaboration within the Department of Medicine and with surgical departments
• Commitment to training, further education and training within the framework of the recognized Category A continuing education center as well as participation in the cross-location further development of geriatric care within the LUKS Group. Opportunity to participate in clinical research and academic development Requirements:
• Specialist title in general internal medicine (FMH or equivalent) with a focus on geriatrics
• Proven clinical expertise in acute geriatrics and geriatric traumatology with a solid anchoring in general internal medicine; Experience in orthogeriatric care and interest in its professional and structural development. Understanding of integrated, interdisciplinary care models
• Leadership experience as well as strong team and communication skills. Ability to classify and help shape organizational and economic relationships
• Interest in the further development of modern, integrated care structures and - preferably - in academic work in teaching and research We offer:
• Central role in the further development and expansion of acute geriatrics and geriatric traumatology at the LUKS with development prospects within the cross-location geriatric care of the LUKS Group
• Creative scope in a clinically and strategically important growth area with the opportunity to provide impulses in the further development of geriatric care models
• Close cooperation in an established interdisciplinary network
• Attractive employment conditions in a modern, university hospital group

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Lucerne Canton Hospital with its Lucerne, Sursee and Wolhusen sites is a company of the LUKS Group and is one of Switzerland's leading hospital groups. The more than 8500 employees are there with cordiality, competence and commitment around the clock for the well-being of patients. The clinics and institutes of the LUKS Group offer medical services of the highest quality. For our team we are looking for backup on 01.10.2026 or by agreement. Tasks:
• Together with your colleagues, you can ensure the diagnostic care of patients at the largest radiological institute in Switzerland (LUKS) and work in the section of abdominal radiology with participation in service
• They are trained by experienced specialist physicians in diagnostic and optionally interventional abdominal radiology (drainages and punctures)
• In addition, you act as a contact person for clinical partner subjects and actively participate in daily operations (teaching, rapports, multidisciplinary conferences)
• There is also the possibility to cooperate in clinical research Requirements:
• They have radiology or are close to them and aim to specialize in abdominaler (and urogenitaler) radiology
• They are of great interest in abdominal and urogenital radiology, possibly also in interventions, and wish to specialize with this aim
• Your initiative, team-ready and independent working processes completes your profile We offer:
• Look forward to working in a collegial and professional environment with state-of-the-art device park (14 MRT 1.5 and 3T), 11 CT (including dual source and cone beam), digital X-ray, ultrasound, angiography, PET-CT and SPECT/CT
• It awaits you a demanding and varied activity in the section for Abdominal Radiology, where your commitment and initiative are desired and appreciated
• Further and further training in all abdominal areas is of course part of our job offer
• You can also benefit from attractive employment conditions and numerous benefits at the largest employer in Central Switzerland

L'hôpital du canton de Lucerne avec ses sites de Lucerne, Sursee et Wolhusen est une entreprise du groupe LUKS et est l'un des principaux groupes hospitaliers suisses. Plus de 8500 employés sont là avec cordialité, compétence et engagement 24 heures sur 24 pour le bien-être des patients. Les cliniques et instituts du groupe LUKS offrent des services médicaux de la plus haute qualité. Pour notre équipe, nous recherchons des renforts au 01.10.2026 ou par accord. Tâches :
• Avec vos collègues, vous pouvez assurer les soins diagnostiques des patients dans le plus grand institut radiologique de Suisse (LUKS) et travailler dans la section de radiologie abdominale avec participation au service
• Ils sont formés par des médecins spécialisés expérimentés en diagnostic et en radiologie abdominale interventionnelle facultative (drainages et perforations)
• En outre, vous êtes une personne de contact pour les sujets cliniques partenaires et participez activement aux opérations quotidiennes (enseignement, rapports, conférences multidisciplinaires)
• Il est également possible de coopérer à la recherche clinique Exigences:
• Ils ont la radiologie ou sont proches d'eux et visent à se spécialiser en radiologie abdominale (et urogène)
• Ils s'intéressent beaucoup à la radiologie abdominale et urogénitale, peut-être aussi aux interventions, et souhaitent se spécialiser dans ce but.
• Votre initiative, vos processus de travail prêts à travailler et indépendants complètent votre profil Nous offrons:
• Au plaisir de travailler dans un environnement collégial et professionnel avec un parc d'appareils de pointe (14 MRT 1.5 et 3T), 11 CT (y compris le double faisceau de source et de cône), radiographie numérique, échographie, angiographie, TEP-CT et SPECT/CT
• Il vous attend une activité exigeante et variée dans la section pour la radiologie abdominale, où votre engagement et votre initiative sont souhaités et appréciés
• Une formation continue et continue dans toutes les zones abdominales fait bien sûr partie de notre offre d'emploi
• Vous pouvez également bénéficier de conditions d'emploi attrayantes et de nombreux avantages auprès du plus grand employeur de Suisse centrale
